chunks: And in the narration of al-Naḍr, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
"Indeed, al-tafath is shaving and what is on the skin of the human being."

key_terms.التَّفَثَ: the state or acts of bodily grooming associated with pilgrimage rites

ai.seo_question: What does al-tafath mean in the rites of hajj according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the meaning of al-tafath in the context of hajj rites. It identifies it with shaving and matters connected to the human skin, clarifying a ritual expression relevant to the completion of pilgrimage acts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3033 - In a narration by al-Nadr from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (as):
"The tafath refers to shaving (the head) and what pertains to the skin of a person."
